json.title: JSON
json.description: Use the JSON parser format to create custom parsers compatible with JSON data.

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: If the log entry provides a field with a timestamp, this option specifies the name of that field.

fields.name: time_format
fields.description: Specifies the format of the time field so it can be recognized and analyzed properly.

fields.name: time_keep
fields.description: If enabled, when a time key is recognized and parsed, the parser will keep the original time key.

fields.name: time_offset
fields.description: Specifies a fixed UTC time offset for local dates.

fields.name: time_strict
fields.description: If true, the parser is strict with the expected time format.

fields.name: time_system_timezone
fields.description: If there is no time zone specified in time_format, enabling this option uses the system time zone.

fields.name: types
fields.description: Specifies the data type of parsed fields using the syntax field:type.

fields.name: decode_field
fields.description: Append structured decoded content to the original log message.

fields.name: decode_field_as
fields.description: Replace a field value with decoded content in the same key.

fields.name: skip_empty_values
fields.description: Specifies whether the parser should skip empty values.

regex.title: Regular Expression
regex.description: Use Ruby-style named-capture regular expressions to parse records into structured fields.

fields.name: regex
fields.description: Required for regex parsers. Specifies the Ruby regular expression for parsing and composing the structured message.
